result.final_text:
## What this letter says
This letter is your appointment for a 20-week scan (anomaly scan).
The scan checks how your baby is growing. It also looks for some physical conditions.
The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do
1. Go to your scan on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15. It is in the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
2. If an interpreter would help you, call the clinic. Call at least 5 working days before your appointment. They will book one for free.
3. You do not need a full bladder for this scan.
4. Children cannot come into the scan room.

## Dates and medicines
- Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15: 20-week scan (anomaly scan). Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
- Interpreter: call at least 5 working days before the appointment on 11 January 2027.
- Medicines: the letter lists none.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen during my scan?
- How can I get an interpreter for my scan?

## When to get urgent help
Call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) straight away if you have any of these before your appointment:
- any bleeding
- leaking fluid from your vagina
- severe tummy pain

The MAU number is 01632 960 456. The line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
